name: Pantheon
title: the Unbreakable Spear

Q.name: Comet Spear
Q.description: Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear, dealing 70/100/130/160/190 + 1.15×bonus AD physical damage to enemies hit. Refunds 60% of this Ability's Cooldown. Hold: Pantheon hurls his spear, dealing 70/100/130/160/190 + 1.15×bonus AD + 0.5×AP physical damage to the first enemy hit and 50% less to further targets. This Ability is enhanced against enemies below 20% Health to deal (70/100/130/160/190 + 85/130/175/220/265) + 2.3×bonus AD physical damage instead. Mortal Will Bonus: Deals an additional 20–240 (by level) + 1.15×bonus AD physical damage.
Q.summary: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.

W.name: Shield Vault
W.description: Pantheon leaps on his target, Stunning for 1 second and dealing 0.06/0.065/0.07/0.075/0.08 + 0.0×bonus max HP + 0.0×AP max Health physical damage. Mortal Will Bonus: Pantheon's next Attack strikes 3 times, dealing a total of (1b016817) × 3 physical damage.
W.summary: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

E.name: Aegis Assault
E.description: Pantheon braces his shield and engages enemies in a chosen direction for 1.5 seconds, becoming immune to non-tower damage from that direction and dealing 1×AD physical damage over the duration. After channeling Pantheon slams with his shield, dealing 55/105/155/205/255 + 1.5×bonus AD physical damage. Mortal Will Bonus: When Pantheon slams his shield he gains 5–30 (by level) + 0.025×bonus max HP Armor and 5–30 (by level) + 0.025×bonus max HP Magic Resist for 4 seconds, and 60% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds.
E.summary: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.

R.name: Grand Starfall
R.description: Passive: Pantheon gains 10/20/30% Armor Penetration. Active: Pantheon gathers his strength to leap high into the air. He throws his spear from above which in a small area deals @spell.PantheonQ:HoldDamageCalc@ physical damage and Slows by 50% for 2 seconds. Pantheon then crashes down as a meteor at the target area. Deals up to 300/500/700 + 1×AP magic damage to enemies in a line (decreased by up to 50% at the edges of the area). This Ability instantly readies Mortal Will.
R.summary: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.

Passive.name: Mortal Will
Passive.description: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.
Passive.summary: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Early-game warrior who bullies lanes with Q poke and point-and-click W stun. Roams with R to snowball before he falls off.
strengths: E blocks damage from one direction

Q.notes: Hold to throw a long-range spear; tap refunds cooldown.

E.notes: Blocks non-tower damage from one direction for 1.5 s; get behind him.

R.notes: Leap and land; slows in area.

Passive.notes: Every few spells/attacks empowers next ability.

profile.windowAgainst: W down: he can't lock you; walk at him. Flank E.
